text: [“] Yes, in those days and at that time, when I restore Judah (praised) and Jerusalem (city of peace) from captivity (restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem),

I will gather all the nations and bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat (the LORD judges). There I will enter into judgment against them concerning My people, My inheritance, Israel (he wrestles with God), whom they have scattered among the nations as they divided up My land.
They cast lots for My people; they bartered a boy for a prostitute and sold a girl for wine to drink.

Now what do you⁺ have against Me, O Tyre (a rock), Sidon (hunting), and all the regions (circuit) of Philistia (land of sojourners)? Are you⁺ rendering against Me a recompense? If you⁺ retaliate against Me, I will swiftly and speedily return your⁺ recompense upon your⁺ heads.
For you⁺ took My silver and gold and carried off My finest treasures to your⁺ temples (palaces).
You⁺ sold the people of Judah (praised) and Jerusalem (city of peace) to the Greeks (to the peoples of Javan), to send them far from their homeland.
Behold, I will rouse them from the places to which you⁺ sold them; I will return your⁺ recompense upon your⁺ heads.
I will sell your⁺ sons and daughters into the hands of the people of Judah (praised), and they will sell them to the Sabeans—to a distant nation.” Indeed, the LORD {YHWH} has spoken.
Proclaim this among the nations: “Prepare for war; rouse the mighty men; let all the men of war advance and attack!
Beat your⁺ plowshares into swords and your⁺ pruning hooks into spears. Let the weak say, ‘I am strong!’
Come quickly, all you surrounding nations, and gather yourselves. Bring down Your mighty ones, O LORD {YHWH}.
Let the nations be roused and advance to the Valley of Jehoshaphat (YHWH has judged), for there I will sit down to judge all the nations on every side.
Swing the sickle, for the harvest is ripe [the harvest has come]. Come, trample the grapes, for the winepress is full; the wine vats overflow because their wickedness is great.
Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the Day of the LORD {Yowm YHWH} is near in the valley of decision.
The sun and moon will grow dark, and the stars will no longer shine.

The LORD {YHWH} will roar from Zion and raise His voice from Jerusalem (city of peace); heaven and earth will tremble. But the LORD will be a refuge for His people, a stronghold for the people of Israel (he wrestles with God).
Then you⁺ will know that I am the LORD your⁺ God {YHWH Eloheikem}, who dwells in Zion, My holy mountain. Jerusalem (city of peace) will be holy, never again to be overrun by foreigners.

And in that day the mountains will drip with sweet wine, and the hills will flow with milk. All the streams of Judah (praised) will run with water, and a spring will flow from the house of the LORD {YHWH} to water the Valley of Acacias (Valley of Shittim).
Egypt (land of bondage) will become desolate, and Edom (red) a desert wasteland, because of the violence done to the people of Judah (praised), in whose land they shed innocent blood.
But Judah (praised) will be inhabited forever, and Jerusalem (city of peace) from generation to generation.
For I will avenge their blood, which I have not yet avenged. For the LORD {YHWH} dwells in Zion.
